text:
It is another woman,
perhaps another,
who is recovering
her hair, her dress, her way;
who now regains
her uprightness,
her weight,
and after lustful, tender sessions
leaves through the door whole and pure,
and does not seek to know,
does not need to,
does not want to know
anything about anyone.

translation.title: Después
